feature_name: Signal API Alignment for Stable and Nightly
description: Modify the Signal API to provide consistent behavior between stable and nightly Rust compilers for the IntoReactiveValue trait. This change will remove the Fn() implementation for Signal<T> and ArcSignal<T> while maintaining function-call syntax through dereferencing, enabling automatic conversion of closures to Signal<_> with #[prop(into)] without requiring Signal::derive() wrappers.
functional_requirements: Remove the Fn() trait implementation from Signal<T> and ArcSignal<T> types
Maintain function-call syntax support for Signal<T> through dereferencing mechanisms
Ensure IntoReactiveValue trait works identically on both stable and nightly Rust compilers
Allow automatic conversion of closures to Signal<_> when using #[prop(into)] attribute without manual Signal::derive() wrapping
Document the workaround for components expecting impl Fn() parameters (manual dereferencing of Signal wrapper)
